company.name: NogBase
company.shortDescription: NogBase is a SaaS solutions tailored for property developers.
company.description:
Nogbase is a leading Proptech innovator, offering advanced SaaS solutions tailored for property developers. Our platform integrates the latest in AI and machine learning to streamline project management, enhance data-driven decision-making, and optimize operational efficiency in real estate development. With Nogbase, unlock the potential of smart technology to propel your property portfolio into the future.
Our mission is to transform how properties are developed, managed, and experienced. Nogbase offers a suite of intelligent tools that streamline project management, optimize operational efficiency, and enhance data-driven decision-making.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $50,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,463,949 to $1,463,949, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 31 (-26).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
